symbols.read: Price has slipped to 742.14, still holding above the 737.2–737.9 bullish FVG but no longer extending the recovery — the four-FVG support stack (725.47–737.9) remains intact, so the bearish case is unchanged in structure though momentum has stalled. The 4H stays bearish and combined signal remains HOLD, keeping the 1H from confirming the downtrend and leaving the 758.57 short MISSED with no trigger. Overhead supply at 762.83–765.18 and 761.47–761.54 still caps upside, with the 721.33 target below the support stack. Bias stays bearish with conviction still weak — invalidation is a reclaim of 758.57, hard stop 775.89, and the BULLISH regime tag continues to conflict with the bearish structure.

Bias stays neutral-to-constructive and has strengthened: price at 83,090.89 is now further above the 82,227.56 lower pivot, and the 1H print is decisively up (+0.82%, 82,567.03→83,246.82) versus the prior read's mild +0.11%, so the bearish 4H/1H alignment still has not re-formed and the SELL setup remains invalidated. The two bull FVGs at 81,028.74–81,425.50 and 81,996.01–82,045.45 remain untouched below as support, with the BULLISH regime non-conflicting. Invalidation for the neutral bias is a 4H close back below 82,227.56, which would revive the short toward 77,730.00; until then 86,725.12 is the upside reference.

Price has pushed marginally higher to 2,499.32 and is now sitting just under the 2,527.57 pivot, still capped by the same bearish 4H direction and 1H downtrend while the combined signal holds at HOLD — no structural break has occurred since the prior read. The bias stays neutral-to-bearish: the 2,465.96–2,468.65 bull FVG remains the immediate support shelf, and a close above 2,527.57 is still the trigger that would break the bearish structure and open the 2,551.76–2,556.06 bear FVG. Failure to reclaim 2,527.57 keeps the path toward the 2,427.00–2,443.52 bull FVG and the 2,320.59 target intact. Invalidation of the bearish lean is unchanged at a close above 2,537.64, and the BULLISH regime tag continues to argue against aggressive short sizing.

Bias stays bearish and the prior read is confirmed: price at 110.48 is still capped under the broken pivot at 115.26, 4H remains bearish, and 108.23 stays the downside objective. What changed is momentum — the last 1H printed +1.42% (109.75→111.31), a sharp pickup from the prior flat +0.04%, so price is pressing up into the overhead supply rather than drifting. The demand stack is unchanged: the 108.00–108.07 bull FVG still sits directly on top of the 108.23 target, while the bear FVGs at 112.89–113.14 and 113.33–114.08 remain open overhead as the first resistance to cap any continuation. Combined reads HOLD with the SELL still flagged missed since entry and stop are both 115.26. Invalidation is unchanged: a 4H close above 115.26 flips the read neutral and voids the broken-pivot thesis, while losing 108.00 opens the next leg down — though the fresh bull FVG at that level means 108.23 is the first real test of whether the downside continues.

XAGUSD has nudged to 60.46, holding the same grind above the 59.07 shelf with the 1H trend still up and the 4H still bearish — the watching stance is confirmed for a third straight read, not revised. The bull FVG stack is unchanged at five zones from 59.12 to 60.02, still sitting beneath price as support, and the combined 4H+1H remains HOLD. Bias stays bearish-but-pending: the short only re-arms on a break back below 58.50, with 58.72 the invalidation stop and 55.14 the target. Sustained trade above 58.72 keeps the setup sidelined, and 61.87 remains the upside pivot — a break above it flips the regime to a long setup with entry 61.87, stop 61.66, and target 65.24.

The confirmed long has been knocked back to watching: price slipped from 4,194.53 to 4,183.07, back below the 4,184.39 trigger and under the 4,185.90 upper pivot, so the breakout reclaim is no longer holding. The 4H direction stays bullish and the 1H trend is still up, but the two bull FVGs that previously sat beneath price have been consumed by this pullback, and a small bear FVG at 4,186.86–4,187.15 now caps overhead. Bias is neutral-to-long on watch, with a fresh entry at 4,185.90, stop 4,177.73, target 4,305.26; invalidation is a break below 4,177.73, which would also threaten the deeper bull FVGs at 4,150.43–4,169.71 and 4,140.87–4,141.58. The combined signal still reads HOLD and the regime NEUTRAL, so this remains a trigger-based setup rather than an aligned trend entry.

Price has closed below the 1.39 reclaim, invalidating the prior neutral-to-long stance and confirming the 4H bearish direction as the dominant input. The 1.39 level has flipped from support to resistance, and with no open FVGs there is no structural shelf between here and the 1.25 target. The 1H trend remains down and the last 1H candle bounced 1.39→1.40, but that is a retest of broken support, not a reversal. Bias is short toward 1.25; invalidation is a close back above 1.39, which would re-open 1.53.
